name: Proton Mail public key server (HKP index)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted): 'Proton: tier trusted, terms open.' (P092 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Authoritative for keys published by Proton for its own addresses; the key creation date only approximates the account creation date (P092 cond 4).

pks.title: Proton public key server HKP index (GET https://api.protonmail.ch/pks/lookup?op=index&search=<address>)
pks.notes: Research C0211 (verified_live 200). text/plain, CRLF lines: 'info:1:N', 'pub:<fpr>:<algo>:<bits>:<created epoch>::', 'uid:...'. 'info:1:0' = no public key published (never 'no account'); an invalid input also answers info:1:0 with 200, so the module validates first. mail-api.proton.me serves the same answers (listed here because it is a Proton key-server host; the module calls api.protonmail.ch only). A public key-discovery directory, not a registration or reset flow: the account.proton.me users/available registration oracle is never implemented (rule 2, P092 cond 5). Endpoint adapted from ProtOSINT (MIT, notice protosint_pks). Used by proton_pks.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G04-1 (P092 proton_pks). Receives an e-mail address (PERSONAL_TYPES): enters the default set only after personal_data_review is recorded (A3 BR8, P092 cond 6).
